title: Godot Mono does not support System.Collections.Immutable
body:
### Tested versions

4.5.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8115) - AMD Ryzen 7 2700X Eight-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

Attempting to use an ImmutableArray in a Godot Mono function which takes a Variant results in the following error:
> E 0:00:23:174   VariantUtils.generic.cs:19 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant Godot.NativeInterop.VariantUtils+GenericConversion\`1.ToVariant(T&): System.InvalidOperationException: The type is not supported for conversion to/from Variant: 'System.Collections.Immutable.ImmutableArray\`1[[Farwoods.src.util.FarwoodsUtilities+Direction, Farwoods, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null]]'
  <C# Error>    System.InvalidOperationException
  <C# Source>   /root/godot/modules/mono/glue/GodotSharp/GodotSharp/Core/NativeInterop/VariantUtils.generic.cs:19 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant Godot.NativeInterop.VariantUtils+GenericConversion\`1.ToVariant(T&)
  <Stack Trace> VariantUtils.generic.cs:19 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant Godot.NativeInterop.VariantUtils+GenericConversion\`1.ToVariant(T&)
                VariantUtils.generic.cs:224 @ Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant Godot.NativeInterop.VariantUtils.CreateFrom<T>(T&)
                Callable.generics.cs:268 @ void Godot.Callable.<From>g__Trampoline|11_0<TResult>(object, Godot.NativeInterop.NativeVariantPtrArgs, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant&)
                DelegateUtils.cs:86 @ void Godot.DelegateUtils.InvokeWithVariantArgs(nint, System.Void*, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant**, int, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_variant*)

I'm using ImmutableArrays to define constant arrays in my game. Godot should probably support the Systems.Collections.Immutable and Systems.Collections.Frozen libraries as they are just immutable variants of generic collections.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an ImmutableArray
2. Pass it as a Variant to the Godot engine
e.g.
```csharp
private static readonly ImmutableArray<int> immutArray = [1, 2, 3];
public override void _Ready()
{
    Connect(Node.SignalName.TreeExited, Callable.From(immutAray.Clear)); //yes, this is strange to do, but it's an example
    QueueFree();
}
```
